description: Kaizen follow-up batch (eb-branch). Small compounding improvements after the settings/keyboard/voice batch (now shipped, all passes:true in git history + docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-16-settings-modernize-keyboard-ux-design.md). This queue: (1) grow the TranscriptCorrector map with mishearings observed in real use, (2) document the dev-app install/trust-gate recipe so the next install skips the hour-long rabbit hole, (3) the deferred strongest voice fix — bias the Mac's WhisperKit decode with Quip vocabulary so the REMOTE path stops mangling at generation time (this one needs a Mac rebuild + manual install/TCC re-grant, so it is LAST). Do NOT rebuild the Mac for US-001/US-002 (iOS/doc only). NEVER push eb-branch without an explicit literal 'push'.

userStories.title: Grow TranscriptCorrector map with real-use mishearings
userStories.description: As a user, I want Quip terms that mangled in real sessions to auto-correct, so voice input keeps getting cleaner over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add high-confidence entries to TranscriptCorrector.defaultPatternMap (QuipiOS/Services/TranscriptCorrector.swift:47): 'finn tech'/'fin tech' -> 'Fintech'; 'whisperers' -> 'Whisper'; 'x code' -> 'Xcode'; 'co dex'/'co-dex' -> 'Codex'; 'tail scale' -> 'Tailscale' and 'mono type' -> 'monospace' (only if not already present — do not duplicate)
Keep the existing matching discipline: word-boundary (the map is wrapped in \b...\b at :60), case-insensitive, applied to final transcript only
CONSERVATIVE: do not add any left-hand side that is a normal English word/phrase (e.g. NEVER add 'pare'/'pay'/'plan'); only unambiguous dev/Quip terms
Extend QuipiOS/Tests/TranscriptCorrectorTests.swift with a case per new term AND a 'leave ordinary prose untouched' assertion
No behavior change beyond the added substitutions
userStories.notes: Added two non-duplicate rules to TranscriptCorrector.defaultPatternMap: `fin+\s+tech`->Fintech ('fin tech'/'finn tech', two-token form only) and `whisperers`->Whisper. The other four PRD terms ('x code','co dex','tail scale','mono type') were ALREADY present from US-005 -> not duplicated. Existing \b…\b word-boundary + case-insensitive + final-transcript-only discipline preserved (new rules ride the same init wrap). Tests: +test_finTech_mapsToFintech, +test_whisperers_mapsToWhisper, +test_newTermNearMisses_notRemapped (singular 'whisperer'/'fin'/'tech' pass through). Gate: xcodebuild build + build-for-testing both SUCCEEDED; standalone swiftc logic check 15/15 PASS (headless XCTest hangs — TEST_HOST=Quip.app). iOS/no-Mac-rebuild. Manual on-device dictation verify (esp. connected/remote path) = user's pass.

userStories.title: Document the dev-app install + trust-gate recipe
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the install steps to warn about the iOS first-trust gate so a future install doesn't turn into an hour of false debugging.
acceptanceCriteria: In README.md, near the existing 'Install iPhone app over the air' section, add a short NOTE block: a development-signed app installed via `xcrun devicectl device install app` will NOT launch until the signing cert is trusted once on the device; `xcrun devicectl device process launch` returns a Security error ('invalid code signature, inadequate entitlements or its profile has not been explicitly trusted') until then — this is NOT a build defect

State the fix: launch once via Xcode Run on the connected device (establishes trust), OR on the phone tap the app then Settings -> General -> VPN & Device Management -> trust the developer; after that devicectl install + home-screen tap work normally
One sentence noting an `id=<device>` Debug build also emits Quip.debug.dylib/__preview.dylib (debugger-coupled); the documented `-destination 'generic/platform=iOS'` recipe is the one to use
Doc-only change — no code, no Mac rebuild
Markdown renders (no broken fences); wording matches the project's existing README voice

userStories.title: Bias Mac WhisperKit decode with Quip vocabulary (remote path)
userStories.description: As a user, I want the remote (Mac Whisper) PTT path biased toward Quip terms at generation time, since that's the path I hit when connected and the iOS corrector only cleans output after the fact.
acceptanceCriteria: Find the Mac transcription call: QuipMac uses WhisperKit (QuipMacApp.swift ~:1722 `WhisperKit(model: "openai_whisper-base")`, transcription via WhisperDictationService). Locate where it builds DecodingOptions / calls transcribe

Seed the decode with a Quip-vocabulary prompt so domain terms win ties: pass prompt/prefix tokens via WhisperKit DecodingOptions (e.g. promptTokens from a short vocab string like 'Quip, Tailscale, monospace, Codex, Grok, Xcode, WebSocket, Whisper, SwiftUI'), guarded so an unavailable API degrades to current behavior (no crash, no regression)
Reuse the same vocabulary source of truth where practical (mirror QuipiOS/Resources/dictation-vocab.txt terms; a small hardcoded Mac-side list is acceptable for v1)
No protocol/wire change required (Mac biases its own decode); if a Shared field is added it must be optional + back-compatible
Gate: xcodebuild (QuipMac, Swift-6) BUILD SUCCEEDED with no new warnings in changed files; add a small pure unit test for the prompt-string/token builder if one is extracted
NEEDS A MAC REBUILD + manual reinstall (TCC re-grant) — mark install + on-device verify as the USER's pass per reference_quip_install_recipe; do NOT block the story on hardware verify
Manual (user verify, connected/remote path): PTT 'Tailscale monospace Codex' shows canonical spelling more reliably than output-correction alone
